not_adopted.item: FP32 seedA/B difference as noise floor
not_adopted.reason: Different search seeds measure optimizer sampling variation, not hardware timing or same-input numerical noise. Repeated same-input crossed timings address the latter separately.

not_adopted.item: BF16 adequate implies no low-bit research need
not_adopted.reason: Ordinary BF16 and INT4 quantization are different interventions; BF16 behavior alone cannot establish INT4 safety. Concrete remaining resource need and actual low-bit implementation remain separate questions.
